newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 11.8 PCT IN 5 MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: INDUSTRIAL SALES UP 11.8 PCT IN 5 MONTHS.

text.p: Estonian industrial sales rose by 11.8 percent in the first five months of 1997 compared with the same period in 1996, the statistics office said on Wednesday.
During the first five months in 1996, industrial sales rose by 0.3 percent.
Manufacturing sales rose 15.6 percent, the department added in a statement.
The biggest rise was in the sales of wood manufacturing products at 53.2 percent and in the sales of construction materials manufacturing at 38.7 percent.
In May, electric energy production rose by 17.2 percent and heat production 6.8 percent compared with the same period in 1996.
